single_hypothesis.statement: A bounded candidate-generation supplement from at most two catalog-IDF-selected strong requirements will recover targets whose decisive constraint is diluted in the blended lexical query, while preserving the complete incumbent candidate union and all non-retrieval policies.

ineligible: a token signature identical to the full lexical query
algorithm.tokenization: existing bounded SQLite FTS tokenization preprocessor with stable deduplication
algorithm.catalog_statistic: SQLite FTS5 fts5vocab row-mode document frequency over the frozen products table
algorithm.specificity_order: ascending smallest positive document frequency among the requirement's known unique terms; this is order-equivalent to descending maximum smoothed IDF
algorithm.probe_query: requirement-only safe quoted-OR BM25 using the existing fields, weights, tie break, and Top-100 depth
algorithm.supplement_merge: round-robin by probe rank, then probe order; add only IDs absent from the complete incumbent BM25/dense union
algorithm.capacity_rule: append supplements to the effective lexical route only until the complete fused union reaches 200; never remove an incumbent union member
algorithm.outer_fusion: unchanged completeness-adaptive two-family RRF; supplements follow the main BM25 Top-100 in the effective lexical rank list
algorithm.cache_dependency: the immutable requirement-probe policy ID is included in the ranking dependency digest only when enabled; the disabled Phase-13 digest path remains exact
algorithm.downstream: unchanged Stage-A, profile residual, intent-epoch slate, clarification, and exact-cache behavior
algorithm.failure_rule: vocabulary or probe faults discard all supplements and return the exact Phase-13 main-BM25 plus dense result for that search; fault-degraded results are not cacheable
algorithm.empty_rule: no eligible, no capacity, duplicate, empty, or no-addition outcomes are deterministic nonfault baseline-equivalent cases
algorithm.additional_calls_per_fresh_search: at most one vocabulary lookup and two local BM25 queries; zero additional dense, embedding, document, model, or API calls

does_not_change: main lexical or dense query rendering

fresh_mechanistic_suite.status: must be generated and locked before candidate implementation
fresh_mechanistic_suite.forbidden_targets: all targets appearing in public and both prior synthetic sources, collected programmatically and never published individually
fresh_mechanistic_suite.selection: official intent_card and coarse_category functions, two distinct non-budget textual hard constraints, frozen broad-family rules, then SHA-256 target ordering
fresh_mechanistic_suite.messages: official Buying first-message template followed by the official answer template for the second hard constraint

development.interpretation: reused generator-separated regression suite, not a fresh holdout

validation.interpretation: reused generator-separated regression suite, not a fresh holdout

predata_gates: fresh suite and aggregate-only lock created before candidate implementation
focused and full unit suites pass
Phase-14 fixed-seed oracle covers at least 30000 cases
Phase-7, Phase-9, and Phase-13 protected oracles remain exact
implementation lock created before any candidate data-suite run

quality_per_suite: candidate HitRate@10 is not below baseline
baseline-hit to candidate-miss transitions equal zero
candidate MRR is not below baseline
candidate MTTC is not above baseline
candidate MRR or MTTC strictly improves
paired bootstrap utility lower 95 percent bound is positive on both generator regressions and non-negative on fresh/public
exactness_and_health: candidate replay and independent construction are exact
at most two probe BM25 calls per fresh search
complete candidate union never exceeds 200 and loses no incumbent member
all product IDs remain valid and unique
zero retrieval, ranking, profile, slate, cache, model, API, token, and privacy faults
exact ranking reuse performs no route or vocabulary calls
performance: candidate warm p95 ratio at most 1.05
candidate total wall-time ratio at most 1.05
additional startup RSS at most 1 MiB
additional retained session state at most 64 KiB

rollback.trigger: any source, oracle, quality, confidence, exactness, fault, call, privacy, latency, memory, or reproducibility gate fails
rollback.action: reject the candidate, keep starter.Agent and benchmarks/phase13.json unchanged, retain candidate code only as inactive research, record aggregate-only evidence, and do not rerun or inspect failed cases
